morphology_as_written: polycrystalline Mg-MOF-74 aggregates were obtained in the absence of H2O
mechanism_as_written: Without water, DOT deprotonates fast and the product is a crystal aggregate.
notes: Broad PXRD peak: aggregates of nanocrystals.

morphology_as_written: the morphology of the aspherical aggregate was observed. These aggregates were joined by ~20 nm Mg-MOF-74 crystallites
when the amount of water was 3 mL, nanosized flaky Mg-MOF-74 crystals with an aspect ratio of ~0.5 were obtained
notes: The stated aspect ratio (~0.5) and the stated length and width (283 nm, 251 nm) do not match each other; both are as written. The same paragraph says hexagonal pillars dominate at 3-9.5 mL (record wu2024-6).

morphology_as_written: monodispersed Mg-MOF-74 single crystals ... crystals with a classic hexagonal pillar shape tend to dominate (3-9.5 mL H2O)
mechanism_as_written: Water slows DOT deprotonation and lowers its solubility, so nucleation slows and crystals grow larger; water also speeds growth along the rod axis more than sideways.

morphology_as_written: Fusiform-shaped crystals were obtained when 13 mL water was added ... length ~9.3 um
hexagonal rods were obtained for CH3COOH ... width ~0.99 um ... length ~2.5 um
varied: capping-agent acidity (acetic, formic, chloroacetic acid, 3 equiv.)
mechanism_as_written: A weaker acid has a more basic conjugate base that binds the metal more strongly and so suppresses growth along the rod axis more.
